senses.definition: A kind of hymn, or canticle, of mediaeval origin, sung in honor of the birth of Christ; a Christmas carol.

quotes.text: The first Nowell the Angel did say / Was to three poor Shepherds in the fields as they lay[…]
quotes.reference: 1833, William Sandys, Christmas Carols Ancient and Modern, page 74:

senses.definition: (archaic) A wish or expression of commemoration of Christmas.
